name: Retro Survival
storyline: In the World of Twelve, adventurers battle waves of creatures across iconic regions. Each encounter allows them to strengthen their powers and acquire new equipment. Their goal: survive the onslaught, defeat powerful bosses, and collect the precious Dofus.
summary:
Retro Survival is a fan-made, single-player survival action game set in the DOFUS Retro universe, playable directly in your browser. Play as a Feca, Iop, Sram, Enutrof, or Osamodas and battle waves of monsters in iconic locations such as Astrub, Litneg Wood, and Wabbit Island.

Real-time combat combines movement, spells, and unique class abilities. As you progress through each run, earn experience, choose upgrades, and combine equipment and spells to shape your character. Take on bosses, collect rare items, and gather the Dofus as you strive to survive for as long as possible.

The game brings the graphics, animations, and sounds of DOFUS Retro into a roguelite survival experience with progressive character development.
